title: Huyghe, Patrick. "UFO Files: The Untold Story." January 1, 1976
doc_notes: This document is an archival article discussing the history of U.S. government involvement and investigations into UFOs; it contains summaries of specific military encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Military personnel at multiple Air Force bases and a Canadian station reported suspicious objects, including objects described as helicopters and jet-like craft, which exhibited maneuvers such as hovering, rapid altitude changes, and lights extinguishing upon interceptor approach.
encounters.location_name: Loring AFB, Wurtsmith AFB, Malmstrom AFB, Minot AFB, and Falconbridge, Ontario
encounters.quote: Reliable military personnel at Loring AFB, Maine, Wurtsmith AFB, Michigan, Malmstrom AFB, Montana, Minot AFB, North Dakota, and Canadian Forces Station, Falconbridge, Ontario, Canada, have visually sighted suspicious objects.
